svg.aria-label: Chronology: capability milestones and later legal steps
svg.title: Chronology: capability milestones and later legal steps
svg.desc: Hexagon: capability milestone. Circle: treaty. Square: resolution or body finding (non-binding). Triangle: unilateral pledge. Open ring: no later legal item paired in the ledger (not a claim that no rule exists). Chronology only: a pair shows which came first, not causation.
svg.text: Chronology: capability milestones and later legal steps
Data as of SWF 9th ed. (Apr. 2026) · Source: SWF 2026 and ledger

svg.desc: Dumbbell chart: for each pair, a hexagon marks the capability milestone and a shape marks the later legal or policy step (circle for treaty, square for a resolution or body finding, triangle for a unilateral pledge). The gap is the elapsed time in years, shown as chronology, not causation. An open ring means no later legal item is paired in the ledger.

g.aria-label: Starfish Prime (1962), then the Limited Test Ban Treaty (1963), which followed it. 1.1 years.
g.text: Starfish Prime (1962), then the Limited Test Ban Treaty (1963), which followed it

g.aria-label: North Korean GNSS jamming (from 2010), then an ICAO Assembly finding on GNSS interference (2025), which SWF also ties to the Baltic case. 15.1 years.
g.text: North Korean GNSS jamming (from 2010), then an ICAO Assembly finding on GNSS interference (2025), which SWF also ties to the Baltic case

g.aria-label: Shakti destructive test (2019), then UNGA 77/41 (2022), a non-binding call not to conduct destructive DA-ASAT tests. 3.7 years.
g.text: Shakti destructive test (2019), then UNGA 77/41 (2022), a non-binding call not to conduct destructive DA-ASAT tests

g.aria-label: Cosmos 1408 destructive test (2021), then a US test moratorium (2022, unilateral pledge). 5 months.
g.text: Cosmos 1408 destructive test (2021), then a US test moratorium (2022, unilateral pledge)

g.aria-label: Baltic-region GNSS interference (from 2023), then an ICAO Assembly finding on recurring GNSS interference (2025). 1.8 years.
g.text: Baltic-region GNSS interference (from 2023), then an ICAO Assembly finding on recurring GNSS interference (2025)

g.aria-label: Jamming of European satellites (2024), then ITU RRB “grave concern” (2024). 4 months.
g.text: Jamming of European satellites (2024), then ITU RRB “grave concern” (2024)

g.aria-label: Laser fired at a satellite (1997): no legal item in the ledger is related to it. No later ledger item is paired with it.
g.text: Laser fired at a satellite (1997): no legal item in the ledger is related to it

g.aria-label: Viasat cyberattack (2022): the only related legal item, Tallinn Manual 2.0 (2017), is soft law and pre-dates it. No later ledger item is paired with it.
g.text: Viasat cyberattack (2022): the only related legal item, Tallinn Manual 2.0 (2017), is soft law and pre-dates it

svg.text: Hexagon: capability milestone. Circle: treaty. Square: resolution or body finding (non-binding). Triangle: unilateral pledge. Open ring: no later legal item paired in the ledger (not a claim that no rule exists).
Chronology only: a pair shows which came first, not causation.

Source: Secure World Foundation, Global Counterspace Capabilities: An Open Source Assessment (9th ed., Apr. 2026) and the primary sources cited in the ledger. Data as of SWF 9th ed. (Apr. 2026). Companion to
Space Security Law: Governance Beyond the Atmosphere.
